Maharashtra Political Developments: MLAs Absent from Uddhav Thackeray's Meeting

Several MLAs were reportedly absent from a meeting convened by Uddhav Thackeray in Maharashtra, fueling speculation about further political shifts following the recent defection of six MPs. Thackeray questioned the unity of the Maha Vikas Aghadi (MVA) alliance. Meanwhile, Thackeray and Chief Minister Eknath Shinde were seen traveling on the same flight, sparking political discussions.
